subject: se
question: What is the purpose of code review? Explain any four benefits of code reviews.
title: A Second Pair Of Eyes
hook: You never spot your own typos, your brain reads what you meant. Code review is a friend who does.
answer: Purpose: to find defects and improve code quality early, before the code is tested or released (teammates read the author's code before it joins the main project).
Benefit 1: early bug detection. A bug found in review costs little; found by users it costs a lot.
Benefit 2: better code quality. Code stays clean, readable and follows the team's standards.
Benefit 3: knowledge sharing. Author learns from the reviewer, reviewer learns the code, so nobody is the only one who understands it.
Benefit 4: team ownership. The code belongs to the team, so anyone can maintain it or take it over.
Memory trick: bugs, quality, knowledge, ownership.
